# pip-audit advisories accepted as the pre-existing backlog.
#
# Recorded 24 Sep 2026 when the dependency gate was introduced: 48 advisories
# in 11 packages (pip-audit prints 93; it lists each one twice), resolved from Backend/requirements.txt on Python 3.12.
# Listing an advisory here does NOT mean it is safe. It means it was known on
# that date, so the gate can block on anything NEW without staying red until
# the whole backlog is paid down. The nightly run audits WITHOUT this list, so
# the backlog stays visible in the job summary instead of disappearing.
#
# Remove a block when the package is upgraded past its fixes. Never add an ID
# to make a PR pass without recording why. Procedure and policy:
# docs/ci/SECURITY_GATES.md#python-dependencies
#
# Format: one advisory ID per line; everything after '#' is ignored.
